_doc: Machine-readable index of open, batch-addressable backlog items for the Routine's systemic-fix mode (prompts/routine2.md §B). The wiki-maintenance session keeps this in sync with the prose backlog pages (ideas/cleanup-backlog.md, ideas/tooling-backlog.md). The selector (pipeline/routine_next.py) picks the lowest-'priority'-number item with status=='open' AND batch_ready==true. EVERY fix is verified per-entry before changing anything (the detectors are read-only review queues); 'fix_type' only indicates how safe the transform is once verified.

items.title: Furigana wrappers with truncated readings (visibly wrong on the live site)
items.filter: subpattern == 'reading-truncated' (do these first), then 'pure-kana' reversed and 'nested'
items.notes: RESOLVED 2026-06-09: Fixed 74 reading-truncated entries (e.g. {やり方|かた}→やり{方|かた}), 9 pure-kana reversed, and 7 nested brace patterns. 130 slash-reading entries remain under the separate furigana-slash-reading item (priority 4).

items.title: U+FFFD replacement-character mojibake in entry text (kanji/readings/inline-link markers)
items.filter: Reconstruct each U+FFFD-run from context: the standard reading of the wrapper's kanji, the headword/reading, or the inline-link delimiter (⟦ ⟧ → ：). Bulk-fix structural-marker and fixed-reading runs; handle ambiguous runs individually.
items.notes: RESOLVED 2026-06-15: swept all 234 corrupted entries (1225 U+FFFD chars) flagged by check_mojibake.py to zero and added a hard U+FFFD guard to build/validate.py so CI rejects any reintroduction. Detector build/check_mojibake.py is read-only and indexed here as a standing guard.

items.title: {ている} furigana-brace artifact in notes/examples
items.notes: RESOLVED 2026-06-10: All 49 entries fixed ({ている} → plain ている in the ASPECT (...) section headers). Each entry opened and confirmed per-entry before saving; furigana self-check screened the 49 changed IDs (5 flags, all rejected as partial-reading false positives, none related to the edit). Detector now reports 0. Brace syntax {X|Y} is for kanji+reading only; {ている} is pure kana so the removal drops no reading.

items.title: Dual-reading furigana with slash separators
items.notes: RESOLVED 2026-06-16: all 118 entries (131 slash-reading wrappers) fixed in one systemic-fix run. Each wrapper replaced with the single reading the kanji actually takes in its headword/compound (rendaku'd form where applicable, e.g. {袋|ぶくろ}, {顔|がお}), the inline-link target's reading where inside a ⟦…⟧ link ({毎年|まいとし}), or the primary reading for standalone/related words ({梅雨|つゆ}). Two malformed English-in-reading wrappers also repaired (28654 {課金|billing/charging}→{課金|かきん}). Per-entry verified against the headword before saving; modified timestamps bumped. Detector now returns 0 slash-reading. Furigana self-check screened 59/118 IDs before the 540s timeout cut it short (logged as a [tooling] observation): 11 flags, all rejected as rendaku/okurigana/partial-reading and screener-truncation false positives, 0 applied.

items.title: cross_references / prominent_see_also entries without a target_id
items.notes: A dangling reference object lacks target_id. Resolve the intended entry id (build/word_id_lookup.json), or drop the reference if no entry exists. PROGRESS 2026-06-17: detector down 190->136 (180->130 entries). Filled target_id on the 54 refs whose headword AND reading both uniquely match an existing entry (provably-correct exact-match resolution; structural diff confirmed only target_id+modified changed). The remaining 136 are 'headword has no entry' cases that need the drop-or-keep judgment per ref (homophone notes like 00250 工夫/こうふ 'laborer' are deliberately labeled pointers to no-entry words; do NOT bulk-drop). Future runs: verify each, drop only genuine dangling refs, leave intentional homophone/contrast notes. PROGRESS 2026-06-19: detector 136->96. Resolved 40 refs across 37 entries: promoted 22 vestigial `id`->`target_id`, repointed 4 stale ids (01040/02032/00373/00213 -> 02500_shinjin/04555_tenkin/00333_ondo/02869_gaikokujin), added target_id to 14 reading/surface-verified refs (incl. reciprocal kana antonym pairs and kanji variants 堪->耐/満ち潮->満潮/交じる->混じる). Self-checked all 37 via furigana screener: clean (6 flags, all partial-reading/misparse false positives, rejected). REMAINING 96 are mostly INTENTIONAL target-less refs: referenced word has no entry, many are homophone/contrast/antonym display labels that must be KEPT (do NOT drop). Captured 14 entry-worthy referenced words as candidates. Recommend refining the detector to exclude type=homophone/contrast (or labeled) refs whose reading has no entry, so this queue converges instead of flagging permanent intentional pointers. PROGRESS 2026-06-20: detector 96->82. Filled target_id on 13 refs (00296/03477/06242/11797/12070/14705/15551/15688/16184/16466/16476/16900/17729) whose headword AND reading both uniquely match a newly-created 29338-29351 entry (curator restock of antonym/related pairs: 有限/小学/独創/実名/能動/低温/高地/父性/好天/近刊/避寒/大食/答申). Provably-correct exact-match resolution, each target read and semantically confirmed. Self-checked all 13 via furigana screener: clean (2 flags, both false positives — model misread どくそうてき, and 毎年=まいとし is valid — rejected). Captured 4 entry-worthy referenced antonyms as candidates (悪徳/急減/軟質/一神教). REMAINING 82 are overwhelmingly INTENTIONAL target-less pointers (referenced word has no entry; homophone/contrast/antonym display labels that must be KEPT). The detector now mostly flags permanent intentional pointers; refining it to exclude type=homophone/contrast/labeled refs whose reading has no entry would let this queue converge instead of re-surfacing the same ~80 every run. PROGRESS 2026-06-21: RESOLVED. Filled the 5 newly-resolvable refs (06214/12651/12671/13899/16910 -> 29383/29371/29369/29368/29370 curator restock antonym/synonym pairs; each target read and semantically confirmed). 0 resolvable target-less refs now remain dictionary-wide. Implemented the 2026-06-19/06-20 detector recommendation: check_artifacts.py missing-target-id now flags ONLY refs whose referenced word has an entry (resolvable); intentional pointers to no-entry words (homophone/antonym/contrast labels, transitivity-pair pointers) are excluded so the queue converges. `--include-intentional` restores the full 77-item audit list. Self-check (furigana screener) on the 5: 1 flag, a false positive (大切 furigana correct), rejected. Captured 10 entry-worthy referenced words as candidates.

items.title: politeness=humble/honorific with no supporting notes
items.notes: Distinguish true keigo from uchi/soto reference forms and bikago. Fix the tag or add the explanation; do not bulk-retag. PROGRESS 2026-06-22: RESOLVED. Detector down 2->0. Verified both flagged entries (23570 つまらないものですが humble; 27145 閣下 honorific); both tags are correct keigo, so added an explicit register sentence to each notes field (謙譲/尊敬) rather than retagging. Self-check (review_accuracy) on the 2: 23570 clean for the register edit but caught a pre-existing not-in-list semantic tag 'social' -> migrated to 'society' (1:1 map); 27145 clean. Kept as a standing check; if new flags appear, re-verify per entry.

items.title: Non-standard but mostly-rendering furigana wrappers (o/go-prefix, pure-kana, over-wrapped okurigana)
items.notes: Mostly cosmetic (canonical form: お{酒|さけ}, {若|わか}い). Lower priority. Verify each rewrap against build/word_id_lookup.json so inline-link lookups still resolve. 2026-06-25 routine swept the 06000-06400 slice (18 instances / 16 entries; 1565->1547). 2026-06-27 routine swept the 06400-06650 slice (30 instances / 24 entries; 1547->1517). 2026-06-28 routine swept the 06650-07300 slice (34 instances / 26 entries; 1517->1485): katakana-loanword de-wraps (コミュニケーション/チーム/コーヒー/クリニック/タオル/ゴキブリ/トイレ/ラベンダー/シニア/プレゼント/ベビーチェア/オストメイト/イクメン/カビ/ブランド), pure-kana de-wraps (やっぱり/しまう/めまい/ふらふら/ひょっとこ/きっかけ), numeral de-wraps ({3|さん}->3, {2|に}->2), o-prefix repositions (お{元気|げんき}, お{客|きゃく}, お{経|きょう}, お{盆|ぼん}), over-wrapped okurigana splits ({旨|うま}み, {卸|おろ}し{金|がね}, {下|お}ろし{金|がね}), and one detector mis-suggestion corrected by hand ({おむつ替|か} -> おむつ{替|か}, not the suggested お{むつ替|か}, since むつ is kana not kanji). 06860 de-wrap was inside an inline link (resolves by entry_id, safe). §4 furigana self-screen: 3 model flags, all rejected (compound-reading-split false positives, none touching the edits). 2026-06-30 routine swept the 07300-07600 slice (24 instances / 18 entries; 1488->1463): pure-kana katakana/kana de-wraps (プロジェクト/スキルアップ/メンバー/チーム/バー/リストラ/タオル/ティッシュ/ボールペン/エコバッグ/ノベルティ/データ/イメージ×2/ボケ), o-prefix repositions (お{金|かね}, お{茶屋|ちゃや}, お{菓子|かし}), over-wrapped okurigana splits ({取|と}り{消|け}し, {女|おんな}の{子|こ}, すり{身|み}, {届|とど}け{出|で}, {太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}), malformed {できる|できない}->できる/できない, and {どこ|}->どこ. §4 furigana self-screen: 2 model flags, both rejected (07459 entry's own いっけん contrast note; 07364 model misread sing->sin, furigana correct). Next ready slice: 07600+ and the larger pre-06000 backlog. 2026-07-01 routine swept the 07600-07900 slice (27 instances / 22 entries; 1463->1436): pure-kana katakana/kana de-wraps (グループ×2/シーン×2/キャラ/サービス×2/コンセント/デジタルトランスフォーメーション/オン/オフ/エンゲージメント/コンプライアンス/ネイル/ネオン/やおい/わきまえる×2), over-wrapped okurigana splits ({素|そ}っ{気|け}ない, {肩|かた}{凝|こ}り, {肩|かた}こり, か{細|ぼそ}い), o-prefix repositions (お{互|たが}, お{世辞|せじ}×3), and two English-source gloss misuses of the furigana wrapper rewritten to plain English ({old girl|オールドガール}->'old girl' in 07715; {old boy|オールドボーイ}->'old boy' in 07716). No inline links touched. §4 furigana self-screen: 21 screened, 0 flags, 1 skipped. Next ready slice: 07900+ and the larger pre-06000 backlog. 2026-07-02 routine swept the 07900-08300 slice (31 instances / 25 entries; 1436->1405): pure-kana katakana/kana de-wraps (ささみ/アナウンス/ゆうパック/パレード/プロ/ステンレス/アルミ/データ/マッサージ/ステーキ/Wi-Fi/バッテリー/エアコン/テレビ/アルバイト/デザイン/パスポート/サラダ/つま/チョコレート/チーズ×2/もう), over-wrapped okurigana splits ({振|ふ}り{分|わ}, {抜|ばっ}てき, {認|みと}め{印|いん}, {御|お}{負|ま}け), and o-prefix/go-prefix repositions (お{土産|みやげ}, ご{飯|はん}×3). No inline links touched. §4 furigana self-screen: 16 screened, 1 flag rejected (07950 {代引|だいび}き okurigana false positive, untouched by edits), 9 skipped. Next ready slice: 08300+ and the larger pre-06000 backlog.

items.title: semantic == ['general'] (under-specified)
items.notes: Low-urgency enrichment, not an error. Only replace 'general' when a specific tag clearly applies from the gloss; otherwise leave it. Large scope — drain slowly.

items.title: formality=formal over-applied to neutral/everyday words in early entries (P17)
items.detect: python3 -c "import json,glob; [print(d['id']) for p in glob.glob('entries/*/*.json') for d in [json.load(open(p))] if (d.get('metadata',{}).get('tags',{}).get('formality')=='formal') and (int(d['id'])<500)]"
items.notes: batch_ready:false — the accuracy-review mode's formality-dimension pass is the right instrument (cross-model signal helps distinguish genuinely formal vocabulary from over-tagged neutrals). The accuracy-review frontier is currently fixing these as it advances through the 00001–00500 range; confirmed range through 00450. Once accuracy-review passes 00500, reassess if a standalone systemic-fix batch is warranted.

items.title: 'descriptive' semantic tag as catch-all on non-mimetic words (P18)
items.detect: python3 -c "import json,glob; [print(d['id']) for p in glob.glob('entries/*/*.json') for d in [json.load(open(p))] if d.get('metadata',{}).get('tags',{}).get('semantic')==['descriptive'] and d.get('metadata',{}).get('tags',{}).get('pos',[''])[0] in ('noun','adjective-na','adverb','conjunction','expression')]"
items.notes: batch_ready:false — fold into the accuracy-review tags pass rather than a dedicated sweep. When reviewing, replace a stray 'descriptive' on an abstract/grammatical word with the right domain tag, or drop it in favour of 'general'. Reserve 'descriptive' for mimetics and manner-quality words. See topics/schema-tag-reliability.md → Undefined tag semantics.

items.title: Concrete semantic tag with no keyword match in the gloss (batch tag drift, P11)
items.notes: P11 is the most pervasive tag-drift problem. The AUTHORITATIVE path for the in-list-but-wrong-category long tail is the accuracy-review mode's LLM tag pass (build/review_accuracy.py --dimensions tags), which judges each semantic tag against the headword (not example topics). For the MECHANICALLY-detectable slices, two high-precision checks were carved out of this noisy heuristic 2026-06-17 and ARE batch_ready: tag-proverb-idiom-mismatch and tag-concrete-noun-domain-mismatch (below). This keyword detector (check_tag_drift.py --check semantic-mismatch) stays batch_ready:false / experimental — it is a free, noisy manual-audit aid only (flags boat=transportation, school=building). Do NOT drive systemic-fix from it; use the two high-precision checks or the accuracy-review tags pass. Remediation prompt: prompts/fix_semantic_tag_drift.md.

items.title: Concrete noun carrying >=2 semantically-distant physical-object domains (P11 garbage multi-tag)
items.filter: optionally add --cohort to restrict to the claude-opus-4-5 batch (highest-density P11 surface)
items.notes: High-precision STRUCTURAL slice of P11: a non-verb headword tagged with two or more mutually-distant hard physical-object domains is the batch garbage multi-tag signature (横断歩道 -> animal-mammal+clothing+transportation; 油絵 -> body-part+tool). Independent of keyword completeness, so it sidesteps the semantic-mismatch noise floor. Measured ~77% clear precision on the first batch (2026-06-17); 18 entries fixed. The residual ~6 are loanword/accessory/fixture polysemy where the dual tag is correct on review (マウス animal+device, 腕時計, ショルダーバッグ, 車席, 電話ボックス, 化粧ポーチ) — VERIFY per entry and KEEP defensible duals; do not force a single tag. Remediation: prompts/fix_semantic_tag_drift.md.

items.title: Proverb/yojijukugo/set-expression tagged with a physical-object domain (P11 furniture family)
items.filter: optionally add --cohort to restrict to the claude-opus-4-5 batch
items.notes: High-precision DETERMINISTIC slice of P11: a proverb/yojijukugo/set-expression headword tagged with a physical-object/creature domain (furniture, clothing, electronics, food, animal-*) with no keyword support — the 一期一会/四苦八苦/起死回生 -> furniture family. Measured ~93% precision (2026-06-17); 14 entries fixed and the detector now returns 0 dictionary-wide. Kept open as a STANDING check (new entries can reintroduce it). Replace the object-domain tag with 'idiom'/'proverb' (or 'expression') after confirming the headword is a set phrase. Remediation: prompts/fix_semantic_tag_drift.md.

items.title: Noun examples that never contain their headword (misparses, wrong-word examples)
items.notes: Two tiers: 'reading-only' (14 — kana reading present without the kanji form; either a cross-boundary misparse like 仕様 inside 直しようがない, or legitimate kana orthography like ごちそう — judge per entry) and 'headword-absent' (129 — example may show a related compound, a verb form of the nominal, or simply the wrong word, e.g. 目玉焼き in the 卵 entry). Replace bad examples with genuine headword examples carrying full inline links, or remove if the entry has examples to spare. Motivating case 00472 仕様 fixed 2026-06-10 (curator-directed). Partial fix 2026-06-11: 9 entries corrected (16 bad examples fixed/removed). Run 2026-06-12_007: 40 more entries fixed (25 removals + 15 replacements); ~45 bad examples removed or replaced. 246 encoding-corrupted entries (U+FFFD in furigana, mostly 20000-29000+) excluded from scope — need a dedicated tooling pass. Remaining scope ~88. Run 2026-06-13: 15 more entries fixed (9 removals + 6 replacements, plus 3 osewa examples corrected). Also fixed 8 tag issues found during self-check. Remaining scope ~73. Run 2026-06-14_routine: adjudicated all 31 currently-flagged entries (53 examples). Only 1 genuine fix — 22875 出回り ex2 used the verb 出回る; replaced with the noun collocation 出回りの時期; self-check also migrated 2 out-of-list semantic tags (commerce→economics, food-drink→food). The remaining ~30 flagged entries are either U+FFFD-corrupted (out of scope — owned by tooling-backlog #16, the mojibake repair pass) or legitimate kana/katakana orthography & ～-prefix headword false positives (ごちそう, おむすび, ヤギ, シミ, カツオ, カキ, しわ寄せ, 〜届 documented compounds, うかんむり radical sense, 〜時). Clean-entry semantic-fix frontier is EXHAUSTED, so batch_ready set false: any genuine headword-absent cases now hiding behind mojibake will re-surface for this lane only after tooling-backlog #16 repairs the corrupted text.

items.title: Out-of-taxonomy semantic tags (post-expansion migration)
items.filter: records whose detail contains 'suggested:' first (1:1 near-duplicate migrations, ~2060 instances), then the long tail
items.notes: Curator tag-policy decision 2026-06-11: VALID_SEMANTIC expanded with 30 established tags (>=100 uses); remaining 9,036 instances across 7,292 entries migrate to in-list tags. Near-duplicates carry suggested targets (TAG_MIGRATION map in check_tag_drift.py) but still verify per entry. accuracy-review prompt v3 also drains this organically. See topics/schema-tag-reliability.md. UPDATE 2026-06-24: free-form cohort continues unbroken into 9240-9456 (~56% out-of-list; 35 error-flags migrated, ~86 residual). Dict-wide ~8,698 flags; per-range accuracy-review cannot drain it alone. UPDATE 2026-06-26: themed sub-batches migrated this window (9741-9814 20%; new shopping/tech cohort 9815-9849 60%). ENFORCE-SIDE SHIPPED 2026-06-25: validate_tags.py --check-no-new-unknown + build/data/unknown_semantic_baseline.json is now a CI step gating NEW off-vocab tags (legacy tail still gradual; live scope re-measured 8,267 instances / 6,759 entries / 1,109 distinct tags). Tooling item 27 full hard-error flip still pending the curated-migration drain. UPDATE 2026-06-28: free-form cohort confirmed contiguous through ~10947 — the 10700-11000 katakana/slang/loanword band is a dense, mostly-1:1-mappable pocket (10716-10887 45/67 flags off-vocab; 10905-10934 a 2026-02 claude-opus-4-6 batch, 25/60 entries); accuracy-review even MISSED ~9 off-vocab tags in a nominally-reviewed 10550-10715 range, so a single scoped check_tag_drift.py --check unknown-semantic sweep over 10700-11000 is the efficient next batch (per-range review cannot drain the dict-wide backlog).

items.title: Inconsistent free-text part_of_speech display field (normalize from canonical tags.pos)
items.detect: TODO: build a read-only detector listing entries whose part_of_speech text != canonical display string for its tags.pos (see tooling-backlog.md#29)
items.notes: Display-text only: tags.pos is canonical and is what renderer/search use, so no functional bug. part_of_speech surface variants coexist dict-wide (adjective (i-adjective) 98 vs i-adjective 256; four suru-verb spellings). batch_ready:false until the normalizer/detector (tooling item 29) exists and the curator agrees the canonical tags.pos -> display-string map (the one editorial choice). Then it becomes a safe text-substitution systemic-fix validated against the structured tag. Changes visible header text on thousands of pages -> spot-check, curator sign-off on the map.
